title: Feature Flag Regression: Deployment and Dependency Outage Simultaneous
description: A deployment enabled a new feature flag 'recommendations-v2' at the same time the recommendation service dependency experienced an outage. Evidence cannot distinguish whether the symptom (recommendation failures) is caused by the new flag code or the dependency outage.
initial_symptoms: New feature flag 'recommendations-v2' enabled at 09:55 UTC
Recommendation service (external) showing degraded at 10:00 UTC
Cannot determine which caused the failures

changes.summary: Feature flag recommendations-v2 enabled via deployment

ground_truth.ambiguity_note: Both the new feature flag code path AND the external recommendation engine outage started at nearly the same time (09:55 vs 10:00). Traces show BOTH code paths (old and new) fail due to the external dependency. Cannot determine if the new code would have worked had the dependency been healthy. The symptom (recommendation failures) is fully explained by the dependency outage; the flag enablement is coincidental in timing.
contributing_factors: No synthetic monitoring of recommendation engine

must_not_claim: Feature flag code caused the outage

misleading_or_confounding_signals: Deployment at 09:55, failures at 10:00 (temporal correlation ≠ causation)
New code path enabled (but old path also fails)

acceptable_alternatives.description: External recommendation engine outage is the cause; flag enablement coincidental
New flag code has bug that manifests only when dependency is slow

required_checks.expected_outcome: Engine shows degraded regardless of flag

required_checks.description: Compare old vs new code path failure rates
required_checks.expected_outcome: Both paths show similar failure rates

required_checks.description: Disable flag and observe if failures persist
required_checks.expected_outcome: Failures persist with flag off (proves dependency cause)

remediation_guidance.suggestion: Cannot determine root cause with current evidence. Recommend: 1) Disable flag to isolate, 2) Wait for dependency recovery, 3) Re-enable flag with canary. If failures persist with flag off → dependency cause. If failures stop → flag code cause.
test_plan: If errors persist: escalate to recommendation engine team
If errors stop: investigate flag code
